So my 15M will arrive.

Best action: produce goods to sell in round 6 market. Shuttle gives 3 goods but border risk ~25%? Tariff 0 currently... shuttle risk always applies (~25%). Shuttle expected 2.25 goods free. Shuttle expected value ~2.25*3alashi ≈ 6.75 vs produce 2*3=6. Slight edge to shuttle.

Also influence: final 5% bonus to max influence. Element 0 has 3 influence. Bribing 15M to reach 4 influence gains 5% of bank = 2.25M — not worth 15M. No.

Choose shuttle (choice 3).
